$schema-note: TICGAL-wide GLPI plugin search-option ID registry. Search options are how a plugin gets a custom, non-blank 'field' label in a native GLPI Historical tab (Log::history()'s id_search_option resolves against SearchOption::getOptionsForItemtype()) — see the glpi-plugin-builder skill's 'History/audit-trail requirement' section and this plugin's ARCHITECTURE.md §3.7 for why these exist. This file exists to keep IDs collision-free BETWEEN TICGAL's OWN plugins (a mechanically checkable problem); it does NOT and cannot guarantee collision-freedom against third-party/public plugins — that can only be verified per-instance with tools/getsearchoptions.php --type=<Itemtype> against the actual target GLPI install before go-live. Workflow for adding a new option: (1) check no entry below already claims that id for the same itemtype; (2) run the collision check tool against a representative live instance; (3) add the entry here in the SAME change that registers it in code; (4) if this ever grows to cover multiple plugin repos, extract this file into a shared 'ticgal-glpi-conventions' repo and have each plugin vendor/submodule it instead of duplicating.

search_options.name: Managed
search_options.purpose: Real, filterable bool search option showing whether a native DomainRecord was imported/is tracked by this plugin's sync (ARCHITECTURE.md §5.7, addendum "Searchable 'Managed' Field on Domain Records") — joined via 'jointype' => 'child' since glpi_plugin_domainmanager_records has a direct, non-polymorphic domainrecords_id FK back to DomainRecord's own id, confirmed against Glpi\Search\Provider\SQLProvider::getLeftJoinCriteria() on the live 11.0.8 source
search_options.verified_collision_free_note: Confirmed against DomainRecord::rawSearchOptions() read directly from the live 11.0.8 source (core options 2,3,4,6,7,8,9,10,80 — none near 9400+); not checked against any third-party plugin, since none besides this one is installed on the instance checked

search_options.name: Proxy status
search_options.purpose: Real, filterable bool search option (same 'child' join shape as 9404) for CDN-proxied records (ARCHITECTURE.md §9 Phase 7 addendum "Searchable 'Proxy Status' Field for CDN-Proxied Records")
search_options.verified_collision_free_note: Same join/table as 9404, checked in the same pass

search_options.name: Managed
search_options.purpose: Real, filterable bool search option: true iff either role (Registrar or DNS) currently resolves to a real, driver-backed, active supplier, independent of last sync success/failure (ARCHITECTURE.md §2, §9 Phase 14 "Domain-level Managed field") — joined via 'jointype' => 'child' since glpi_plugin_domainmanager_states has a direct, non-polymorphic domains_id FK back to Domain's own id

search_options.name: NS Provider
search_options.purpose: Real, filterable search option for the NS-detected DNS provider (ARCHITECTURE.md §9 Phase 15 addendum "Searchable fields") — 'datatype' => 'specific' with a dropdown built from NsProviderRegistry::getProviders() (DomainState::getSpecificValueToSelect()), same 'child' join shape as 9406

search_options.name: Registrar sync status
search_options.purpose: Real, filterable search option for the registrar leg's last sync outcome (ARCHITECTURE.md §9 Phase 15 addendum "Searchable fields") — 'datatype' => 'specific' with a dropdown from DomainState::getStatusLabels() (DomainState::getSpecificValueToSelect()), same 'child' join shape as 9406

search_options.name: DNS sync status
search_options.purpose: Same as 9408, for the DNS leg.

search_options.name: Last sync
search_options.purpose: Real, filterable/sortable native 'datetime' search option (ARCHITECTURE.md §9 Phase 15 addendum "Searchable fields") — no custom display/select needed, same 'child' join shape as 9406
